source_refs.title: Set up iCloud Photos on all your devices
source_refs.section: Set up iCloud Photos on your iPhone or iPad
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; the page gives no version limits for this setup
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Tap Photos, then turn on Sync this iPhone.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Make sure you're signed in to the same Apple Account on each device. On your iPhone or iPad, go to Settings > [your name] > iCloud. Tap Photos, then turn on Sync this iPhone.

source_refs.applicability: Android phone or tablet; the page gives no Android version for these steps
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: On your Android phone or tablet, open the Google Photos app. Sign in to your Google Account. At the top right, tap your Profile picture or Initial. Tap Photos settings and then Backup. Turn Backup on or off.
